objective: Proof: bond polygons have weight exactly 3(m - 2) with every member on a geodesic between its neighbours; the excess formula; the candidate lemma and the polygon search.
status: Proved 2026-11-18 (referee pending): on weave patches without holes a bond's tight cyclic order is a geodesic polygon of weight exactly 3(m - 2); the excess of bond distance over steps apart + 1 is the least bond polygon's extra length over the round trip in units of 3; a least bond's members lie within detour 3e of the round trip; hence an exact bond search without states.
title: Bond polygons and the excess
